title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: The basics
hook: When did your team last practice the plain basics?
statement: The basics are boring until they win games.
q1: Do you drill basics every practice —
q2: or hide them inside games so kids do not notice?
q3: Which basic skill costs you most in games?
t1: Both can work. But games get easier
cta: Coaches — how do you teach basics?
ctaLines: Ten minutes every practice. Hidden in games. Both.
Straight drills or hidden in games?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
When did your team last practice the plain basics?
Kids want to scrimmage. Their throwing still needs work.
The basics are boring until they win games.
Drill the basics directly or hide them in games. There is no perfect answer.
How do you teach basics? Share your habit in the comments.
